title: Generation Life unveils protection feature for LifeIncome
full_text:
Generation Life unveils protection feature for LifeIncomeBY MATTHEW WAI | TUESDAY, 17 NOV 2026 11:06AMGeneration Life has debuted a new feature within its LifeIncome investment-linked lifetime annuity to protect members' income for up to five years. ConfidencePlus aims to provide retirees protection of their retirement income while retaining the potential for uncapped income growth for investment-linked lifetime annuity members when market turmoil occurs. For up to five years on all or a selected portion of their investment, if investment performance delivers a higher income on the protected portion, the members will receive the higher amount, the annuity provider said. The feature can be selected when starting a LifeIncome investment or added later and is available with BlackRock's Enhanced Strategic Model Portfolio investment options. Investors can also renew their protection at any time, with a new premium and minimum income level calculated at each renewal, subject to applicable product terms, Generation Life said. Notably, the minimum income guarantee provided under ConfidencePlus is supported by a new reinsurance arrangement with Munich Re. The launch builds on BlackRock's acquisition of a minority stake in Generation Development Group, the parent company of Generation Life in May 2025. Commenting, Generation Life chief executive Felipe Araujo said the launch reflects a growing need for greater flexibility and certainty in retirement income planning. "Australia has built a world-class retirement savings system with $4.8 trillion in super assets. The next challenge is helping Australians turn those savings into an income they can confidently rely on throughout retirement," he said. "At Generation Life, we see a significant opportunity to expand the range of retirement income solutions available to financial advisers and their clients. ConfidencePlus is an important step in that direction. "For financial advisers, it provides another way to tailor retirement income strategies to individual client needs, balancing greater income certainty with flexibility and the potential for income growth." Meanwhile, BlackRock head of investment strategy for Australasia Katie Petering said the launch reflects the role investment innovation can play in helping advisers meet increasingly complex client needs. "Retirement investing requires a different approach to managing wealth. Investors need to draw an income from their investments while managing market volatility and making their savings last," Petering said. "By bringing together BlackRock's global investment capabilities and portfolio construction expertise with Generation Life's lifetime income expertise, we're helping expand the range of solutions available to financial advisers as they respond to their clients' evolving needs."
